summary: The filing reports routine unregistered sales of Class I and Class S common stock by Vista Credit Strategic Lending Corp. under subscription agreements, relying on exemptions under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S. A total of 158,374.045 shares were sold for $3,029,800; no price per share, premium, or board recommendation is provided. The filing also discloses a preliminary NAV per share of $19.13 as of June 30, 2026. This is an ordinary capital raise by a BDC, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, activist campaigns, or strategic changes; it is a routine securities issuance and NAV update.
